meta.method: Each usable model is fetched from the Open-Meteo Previous Runs API for the same 68 cells and April–November 2024–2026 window as pipeline/hindcast.py, one multi-coordinate call per model per month (all previous-day leads in that one call). Hourly precipitation is summed to Africa/Lagos calendar days. Each model is then quantile-mapped to IMERG per lead day, pooling cells, with the same trust folds as pipeline/calibrate.py (2024 fit on 2025, 2025 fit on 2024, 2026 fit on 2024+2025) so every flood-day number is out of sample. The fair comparison is at a fixed alarm budget: on 2024+2025, ECMWF IFS at its 15 mm calibrated rule flags a known number of days; every other model (and each blend) gets the threshold that flags as close as possible to that many days on 2024+2025. That threshold is frozen before 2026 is scored. Brier skill for ≥ 20 mm and the calibrated p99 use full leave-one-season-out. Blends are the mean of the calibrated totals; the best two models are the two with the most 2024+2025 day-1 flood days caught at the matched budget, frozen before 2026 is looked at.

blend.rule: mean of calibrated daily totals (all members must be present)
blend.best_two_chosen_by: most 2024+2025 day-1 flood days flagged at the matched budget; 2026 was not used to pick the members

recommendation.why: No usable model caught more of the 19 flood days than ECMWF IFS (11) at the same alarm budget. The best-two blend (ecmwf_ifs025+gem_global) caught 10 (p = 1.0). Stay on the ECMWF 51-member ensemble; a deterministic other model is not earning its extra API call.

api_cost.live_today: The live run makes 1 Open-Meteo Ensemble call for ECMWF IFS 0.25 (51 members) and 1 for GFS 0.25 as an uncalibrated second opinion, plus 4 Flood API calls. Weather-model cost is 2 forecast calls/day.
api_cost.switch_headline_to_other_ensemble: Still 1 headline ensemble call/day if that model has an ensemble on the Ensemble API (ICON and GFS do; ARPEGE/GEM/JMA/CMA/BOM deterministic would replace the 51-member chance ladder with a single run). Recalibrate first. Do not do this from this file alone.
api_cost.add_second_opinion: 1 extra Ensemble or Forecast API call/day per added model. A deterministic second opinion can raise or lower a cell's level when it disagrees with the ECMWF ensemble median, but it cannot replace the 51-member chances.
api_cost.blend: 1 Forecast/Ensemble call/day per member of the blend. A mean of deterministic totals is not an ensemble: it can be a second opinion on the daily total, not a replacement for P(≥ 40 mm).

caveats: This comparison scores one deterministic Previous Runs series per model, not the 51-member ECMWF ensemble the live product uses. A deterministic model can only adjust those chances or act as a second opinion.
Quantile mapping restores the size of rain a model already saw; it cannot invent a storm the model never placed on Lagos.
The reported-flood catalog undercounts real floods, so a flagged day with no report is not proof no flood happened.
With 19 flood days, McNemar will usually call a difference noise. The vs_ecmwf.plain field on each row says so when it is.
